description: Ministry of Housing & Construction - Notify the Construction Industry Development Registration of Quality Management Auditor's  Rules of 2017 - The Construction Industry Development (Registry of Constructors Rules of 2017)
reasoning: This gazette content contains rules and regulations made by the Construction Industry Development Authority under the Construction Industry Development Act, No. 33 of 2014. It establishes regulatory frameworks for contractor registration and quality management auditors, specifies qualification requirements, and outlines registration procedures and fees. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it creates subsidiary legislation and compliance requirements.
